articles.headline: Ugonna Onyenso thought his NBA dream was over -- then the Detroit Pistons called him up
articles.description: Detroit Pistons center Ugonna Onyenso was surprised to hear his name called out 53rd at the 2026 NBA Draft, having once believed his dream of making the league was over, but is now confident he can grow into the sizable shoes left by Isaiah Stewart.

article.headline: Clingan has 20 points and 19 rebounds, Trail Blazers beat Grizzlies for 2nd consecutive night
article.description: — Donovan Clingan had 20 points and 19 rebounds, Jerami Grant had 29 points, and the Trail Blazers erased an 11-point second-half deficit to beat the Memphis Grizzlies 122-115 on Saturday night and split a two-game series in Portland.
article.linkText: Clingan has 20 points and 19 rebounds, Trail Blazers beat Grizzlies for 2nd consecutive night

images.name: Jerami Grant spins to the basket for 2
images.caption: Jerami Grant makes a nice move to the rim and gets it to go.

article.story: PORTLAND, Ore. -- — Donovan Clingan had 20 points and 19 rebounds, Jerami Grant had 29 points, and the Trail Blazers erased an 11-point second-half deficit to beat the Memphis Grizzlies 122-115 on Saturday night and split a two-game series in Portland. Portland beat the Grizzlies 135-115 on Friday. Jrue Holiday had 21 points and Caleb Love scored 17 points, 10 in the second half, off the bench. Olivier Maxence-Prosper (25 points) and Javon Small (22 points) each had career nights for Memphis in the loss. Portland’s All-Star forward Deni Avdija missed his fourth straight game with a lower back strain. Scoot Henderson also missed Saturday’s game after making his return from a torn hamstring on Friday. Jahmai Mayshack’s 3-pointer pushed the Memphis advantage to 104-97 before Portland made its final push. Vit Krejci, Toumani Camara and Love each hit a 3-pointer before Love stole the ball and made a layup to give Portland a 108-107 lead with 5:59 left in the game. Javon Small’s 3-pointer cut Portland's lead to a point about three minutes later but Holiday answered with a layup before Grant made back-to-back 3s to give the Trail Blazers a 120-113 lead with 1:51 left. There were eight ties and 18 lead changes in the game. Up next Portland: Hosts Philadelphia on Monday. Memphis: Plays Monday at Golden State. ------ AP NBA: https://apnews.com/hub/NBA
